referenceMachine: Ampex ATR-124. Only its architecture is taken from public sources so far: three speeds, 24 channels, a servo capstan with no pinch roller, and transformerless op-amp electronics. The service manual has not been read, so every performance number below is an assumption. No hardware was measured. This is not a claim of equivalence to that product.
status: provisional: architecture from public descriptions, performance values assumed pending the service manual; not validated; not listened to

evidence.referenceDbfs: assumed: host convention that operating level sits at -18 dBFS
evidence.format.trackWidthInches: standard: 43 mil tracks of the two-inch 24-track format
evidence.tape.coatingThicknessMicrons: assumed: about 0.55 mil oxide for a high-output tape of the period; not verified
evidence.tape.hd3PercentAtCal: assumed: 3 percent third harmonic taken as the usual maximum-output criterion
evidence.tape.hd3CalLevelDb: assumed: 9 dB above operating level for a high-output tape; not from the manual
evidence.head.headBumpGainDb: assumed: no published low-frequency response read yet
evidence.electronics.transformers: published: manufacturer advertisement (Recording Engineer/Producer, April 1980) states transformerless differential line inputs, outputs and head coupling with op-amp signal processing
evidence.electronics.maxOutputDb: assumed: no figure read for this machine
evidence.electronics.highpassHz: assumed: direct-coupled design, low corner chosen
evidence.transport.flutterComponents: assumed: rates are placeholders. published architecture only: the operations manual excerpt states there is no capstan pinch roller, with a capstan servo for speed and a reel servo for tension
evidence.speeds.equalization: published: three speeds, 7.5, 15 and 30 in/s. assumed: equalization standard per speed
evidence.speeds.playbackHfCornerHz: assumed: no response tolerance read yet
evidence.speeds.flutter: assumed: low values chosen for a servo transport with no pinch roller; no figure could be attributed to this machine with confidence
evidence.speeds.snrDb: assumed: no figure read for this machine
